feed.title: RSS System Design Articles: Top 3
feed.subtitle: The top 3 system design articles of each day, by publication date (every picked article on a day with 3 or fewer). Summaries and Classifier leverages AI; may contain errors.

entry.title: How Anthropic Redesigned Source Control
entry.summary: Shows the design decision to replace Git mirrors with Scion, which moves history, diffs and commits to a server backed by Spanner and content-addressed caches, trading client independence for service dependence at 25 million CI checkouts per day.

entry.title: Improving a basketball shot expected-value model with pose estimation (translated from Japanese)
entry.summary: Shows the design decision to switch from 2D ViTPose++ to 3D SAM 3D Body pose and fix monocular scale by linear least squares over 18 frames with ground, parabola and smoothness terms, raising AUC from 0.6696 to 0.6731.

entry.title: Scaling Model Evaluation at Pinterest with Ray (Part 4)
entry.summary: Shows the design decision to fuse metric computation into Ray batch inference with a `ReducibleMetric` partials contract, trading an exact global sort for threshold confusion matrices on ROC-AUC, cutting evaluation time by up to 32%.

entry.title: Sequential Store: building the foundation for Block’s foundational models
entry.summary: Architecture walkthrough of the Sequential Store, which standardizes hundreds of event streams with config selectors, keeps an append-only label vocabulary across versions, and redesigned deduplication keys and monitors after silent failures dropped over a year of rows.

entry.title: Cost per task: Using cheap classifiers to route across Gemini models and thinking levels
entry.summary: Shows the design decision to route coding-agent tasks with a cheap classifier from Flash-Lite to Gemini 3.8 Flash on low thinking, and its trade-off with per-model context caching, after a keyword heuristic fell to 70.6% on held-out tasks.

entry.title: F3 Lightning: How Meta Accelerates Ads ML Features to Production at Scale
entry.summary: Shows the design decision to split the release unit from the shared execution graph in F3, using stable computation identifiers, one startup execution plan, a shared request buffer and dense index slots to keep CPU cost flat.

entry.title: Learning new skills without forgetting: Self-Distillation vs GRPO
entry.summary: Shows the design decision between Self-Distillation and GRPO for continual post-training, weighing GRPO's higher compute against forgetting, as self-distilled Nemotron lost 30 points on logic while GRPO never dropped more than 0.2 points.

entry.title: Meituan officially releases LongCat-2.5: a native multimodal model for agentic tasks (translated from Chinese)
entry.summary: Architecture walkthrough of LongCat-2.5 training and inference, covering supernode-aligned parallelism, threshold-triggered expert replication, dual-sharded FSDP with 86% higher per-card throughput, and W4A4 inference with 43.3% higher prefill throughput.

entry.title: Keep Distributed Training Running with Automated Workload Recovery
entry.summary: Architecture walkthrough of NVIDIA Recovery's detect, attribute, isolate and restart loop behind a scheduler-independent Advisor API, which recorded about 8,550 anomaly detections with a 94-second mean recovery-action latency on one cluster.
